SVRTBW

The National Weather Service in Ruskin has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Northeastern Manatee County in west central Florida...
Southeastern Hillsborough County in west central Florida...

* Until 515 PM EDT.

* At 450 PM EDT, a severe thunderstorm was located near Parrish, or
15 miles east of Palmetto, moving northwest at 10 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

* Locations impacted include...
Bradenton, Little Manatee River State Park, Lake Manatee State
Park, Ruskin, Ellenton, Parrish, Wimauma, Greater Sun Center, and
Sun City Center.

SMWTBW

The National Weather Service in Ruskin has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Coastal waters from Englewood to Tarpon Springs FL out 20 NM...
Tampa Bay waters...

* Until 615 PM EDT.

* At 443 PM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 32 nm east of Hillsborough Bay to 8 nm east of Terra
Ceia Bay to near Sarasota Bay, moving northwest at 20 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, frequent lightning, and heavy downpours. Make sure
all on board are wearing life jackets.

* Locations impacted include...
Terra Ceia Bay, Manatee Nearshore Reef, Howard Frankland Bridge,
Madeira Beach Reef, Tierra Verde, Belleair Beach, Cockroach Bay,
Anna Maria Island, Pass-A-Grille Channel, Southwest Channel, Tampa
Bay, St. Pete Beach, Hillsborough Bay, Bradenton Beach, Honeymoon
Island, Redington Beach, Whitney Beach, Courtney Campbell Causeway,
Clearwater Pass, and Pass-A-Grille Reef.

events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
The National Weather Service in Medford has issued a Fire Weather
Watch, which is in effect from Monday afternoon through Monday
evening.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will likely spread rapidly.

* AFFECTED AREA...In California...The Scott Valley in Fire weather
zone 280, Fire weather zone 281, Fire weather zone 284 excepting
the southeast portion of the zone, and Fire weather zone 285. In
Oregon...Fire weather zone 624, excepting the Highway 97 corridor
from Modoc Point to Chemult.

* WIND...South winds 10 to 20 mph with gusts to 30 mph in the Scott
Valley, and 15 to 25 mph with gusts to 35 mph in the Shasta
Valley. Elsewhere, southwest winds 10 to 20 mph with gusts to 30
mph.

* HUMIDITY...Minimum humidity 9 to 15 percent.

* DETAILED URL...View the hazard area in detail at
https://weather.gov/wrh/hazards?wfo=mfr
